title: Design System: A V Car Mobile Mechanic

cobalt.note: This build's own accent axis. Lighter than the deep Spode blue so small label text clears 4.5:1 on graphite (measured 5.75:1 on ground, 5.41:1 on panel).

cobalt-bright.note: The hover state everywhere: button fill, ghost text, link and phone hover.

cobalt-deep.note: Light-asset only: falloff stops in public/kerbside.svg and public/kerbside-close.svg. Never carries text; it does not clear 4.5:1 on graphite.

cobalt-ink.note: The foreground on cobalt: primary button label and selected text. Nothing else.

hairline.note: The only structural device in the system. 1px, used for every rule and border.

hairline-strong.note: Ghost button stroke, tick dividers, the unfilled half of a star.

display.purpose: The name lockup and the closing phone number only. Two per page, both decision points. Uppercase at wdth 125.

title.purpose: Service row titles at wdth 118; town names run a size above at wdth 122.

body.purpose: Service copy at 62ch, leads at 42-56ch. Sentence case, normal width, never stretched.

label.purpose: The house label tier: plate head, contact labels, hero foot rail, review source. Uppercase, 0.16em.

label-sub.purpose: One step under the label tier, in steel dim, for rows inside a container that already carries a house-tier label.

shadows.name: cobalt-bloom
shadows.purpose: The primary call button only. Reads as the button glowing, not floating. Never on a card, plate or panel.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Every hover, colour and transform state change.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance: 900ms rise with 14px translate, staggered 60/150/240/330/420ms, and the 1400ms lamp fade from blur(20px). Both are inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

assets.name: kerbside.svg
assets.purpose: Hero light. Directional, low-left, seven-stop cobalt falloff plus a masked road wash, a street-light wash and baked fractalNoise grain at 0.055 overlay. Gradient opacity runs roughly double the amber sibling's because cobalt is a darker hue on the same graphite.

assets.name: kerbside-close.svg
assets.purpose: Closing band light. Same lamp turned down and centred in its own asset, directional washes dropped.

assets.name: icon.svg
assets.purpose: Favicon: a drawn hex nut in cobalt stroke on graphite, no fill, flats that still read at 16px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The call. The loudest cobalt on the page, and the only element carrying a shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.95rem 1.7rem; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-stretch: 112%; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #4d89f5; color: #04101f; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -14px rgba(77, 137, 245, 0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7fa9ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d89f5; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. A hairline stroke, no fill, and it never gets equal mass to the call on a phone.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.95rem 1.7rem; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.22); background: transparent; color: #f3f5f7; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-stretch: 112%; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #4d89f5; color: #7fa9ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d89f5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sticky Topbar
components.description: The only navigation: a wordmark and the phone number as a small primary button, present at every scroll position.

components.css: .ds-topbar { background: rgba(11, 13, 17, 0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); } .ds-topbar-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; min-height: 64px; padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem; max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-brand { color: #f3f5f7; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-stretch: 118%; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-small { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 3px; background: #4d89f5; color: #04101f; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-stretch: 112%; text-decoration: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-small:hover { background: #7fa9ff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-small:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d89f5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review Card
components.description: The only filled card in the system. Quote on top, hairline rule, then name and source.
components.css: .ds-review { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #12151b; border: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); border-radius: 5px; padding: 2rem 2rem 1.7rem; margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-review-quote { flex: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 1.38rem; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #f3f5f7; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-review-attrib { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6rem; margin-top: 1.7rem; padding-top: 1.2rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); font-size: 0.88rem; } .ds-review-name { color: #f3f5f7; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-review-source { color: #969ea8; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-plate { background: rgba(18, 21, 27, 0.66); border: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1.6rem 1.7rem 0.4rem; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 420px; } .ds-plate-head { margin: 0; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4d89f5; padding-bottom: 1.15rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); } .ds-plate-list { margin: 0; } .ds-plate-row { padding-block: 1.1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); } .ds-plate-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-plate-row dt { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #969ea8; } .ds-plate-row dd { margin: 0.55rem 0 0; color: #c1c7cf; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Half-Star Rating
components.description: Five authored star paths filled to the real score by a hard-stop gradient, so 4.5 shows four solid and one exactly half full. No rounding up, no icon font.
components.css: .ds-rating { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: #f3f5f7; } .ds-stars { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-star { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-score { font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tick { width: 1px; height: 14px; background: rgba(243,245,247,0.22); } .ds-count { color: #c1c7cf; font-size: 0.95rem; }

components.css: .ds-towns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.9rem 3rem; margin: 0; padding: 2.4rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(243,245,247,0.12); list-style: none; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: #f3f5f7; } .ds-town { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.15; text-transform: uppercase; font-stretch: 122%; letter-spacing: 0.005em; } .ds-town::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: none; transform: translateY(-0.35em) rotate(45deg); background: #4d89f5; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-towns { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.85rem; } }

components.name: Service Row

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Inline links: white with a hairline underline held 4px off the baseline, going cobalt on hover.

narrative.northStar: The Inspection Lamp Set Down On A Road
narrative.overview:
This is the house dark-professional canon shared with the same owner's Showroom Shine, CJ Valeting and M&A Auto Service sites, run here in Spode cobalt. The ground, the text ramp, the hairlines, the radius set, the rhythm scale, the motion pair and the Archivo type treatment are canon and are identical across the family. The accent is the only permitted axis of divergence: change the hue, change nothing else. A reference implementation of the same system in signal amber sits at /Users/realm/maautoservice.

Two things this client forced that the siblings did not. First, cobalt is a darker hue than amber, so it needs a lighter working token to clear 4.5:1 against graphite for small label text, and roughly double the gradient opacity of the warm sibling to throw the same amount of light on the same ground. Second, the trade is mobile, so coverage is a fact the page owes the visitor and it gets a section of its own, set at display scale between two dense sections. Neither is a house change; both are this build's own.

The page has no photographs and none may be invented, so the hero is lit rather than shot. The light is a produced asset with seven authored falloff stops and grain baked in, not a stack of flat CSS ramps, and it appears exactly twice. Everything else is flat: hairline rules carry all structure, the review row is the only place a filled card is allowed, and cobalt is rationed hard enough that the call button stays the loudest thing on the page.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite near-black ground run a degree cooler than the amber sibling, to sit under cobalt
Hairline rules (1px at 12% white) as the only structural device
One rationed chromatic accent: labels, stars, ticks, town markers, CTA, phone number
Wide-stretched Archivo caps against plain sentence-case body
Flat by default; produced light instead of shadow, twice on the page
Facts over decoration: every hero-plate row restates something the page proves elsewhere

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only chromatic hue on the page. A second hue anywhere, including inside the light assets, breaks the world; the lamp is lit in cobalt for exactly this reason.

rules.name: The Working Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Small text, glyphs and controls take the working cobalt. The deep Spode value stays inside the light assets, where nothing has to be read off it.

rules.name: The Accent-Only Divergence Rule
rules.body: When this system is carried to another site in the family, the accent hue is the only token that may change. Ground, steel ramp, hairlines, radii, rhythm and type stay as they are.

rules.name: The Ration Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is spent on labels, stars, ticks, town markers, the two call buttons and the phone number. Inside the hero plate it is limited to the plate head and the stars so the call button remains the loudest cobalt in the first viewport.

rules.name: The Stretched Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and a width axis above 110% belong to headings, labels and buttons. Body copy is sentence case at normal width. Never stretch a sentence; never set a heading unstretched.

rules.name: The One Label Tier Rule
rules.body: A container that already carries a label at the house tier sets its interior labels a step below it in steel, not a second colour at the same size.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers that a visitor may compare or dial (rating score, phone numbers, hours) set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The First Viewport Rule
rules.body: The hero foot rail lands inside the first screen on a phone. Anything that would push it under the fold stands down, and what stands down must be restated in full further down the page.

rules.name: The Two Lamps Rule
rules.body: The produced light appears exactly twice: directional and low-left behind the hero, centred and turned down behind the closing phone number. A third instance turns a device into wallpaper.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Filled Rule
rules.body: Where a band needs presence, light it with the produced asset. Do not reach for a CSS gradient ramp; a blue gradient hero is the stock template this world exists to refuse.

dos: Do run structure on hairlines. A new section opens with a 1px top rule and the section pad, not with a box.
Do keep cobalt to labels, stars, ticks, town markers, the call buttons and the phone number.
Do use the working cobalt for anything that must be read; leave the deep Spode inside the light assets.
Do set headings uppercase with the width axis above 110% and body sentence case at normal width.
Do author a produced SVG light when a band needs presence, with real falloff stops and baked grain.
Do give every interactive element a :hover, an :active and a visible cobalt focus ring, and cancel every transform under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do author grid breaks where a wrapping run would rag badly, and lead ornaments rather than separating with them.
Do carry this system to a sibling site by changing the accent hue alone.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic hue, in CSS or in an asset.
Don't put a filled card anywhere but the review row; every other grouping is a hairline.
Don't add a third instance of the produced light.
Don't build a lit band out of CSS gradient ramps.
Don't stretch body copy or set a heading at normal width.
Don't use a glyph icon font or a borrowed icon set; the star, the diamond and the favicon nut are authored paths.
Don't let a container show two label colours at the same size.
Don't give a secondary action the same mass as the call on a phone.
